mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TB_IF_DATA ( CST_COD, SEND_DAT, SEND_SEQ, IF_KEY, DATA_TYP, DOC_TYP, SND_DAT, ARV_DAT,
CST_SND_CST_COD, CST_SND_CST_NAM, CST_SND_CST_TEL, CST_SND_CST_ADDR,
CST_ORD_CST_COD, CST_ORD_CST_NAM, CST_ORD_CST_TEL, CST_ORD_CST_ADDR,
CST_ARV_CST_COD, CST_ARV_CST_NAM, CST_ARV_CST_TEL, CST_ARV_CST_ADDR,
PRD_COD, DLV_QTY, CHIT_NUM, CAR_NUM, TRN_CST_NAM, DRIVER_NAM, DRIVER_TEL,
ITEM, ETC_DESC, KPP_GET_YN, REG_DAT ) VALUES ( #{CST_COD},
NVL(#{SEND_DAT}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')), NVL(TO_NUMBER(#{SEND_SEQ}), 0), NVL(#{IF_KEY}, ' '),
NVL(#{DATA_TYP}, ' '), NVL(#{DOC_TYP}, ' '), NVL(#{SND_DAT}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')), NVL(#{ARV_DAT}, ' '),
NVL(#{CST_SND_CST_COD}, ' '), NVL(#{CST_SND_CST_NAM}, ' '), NVL(#{CST_SND_CST_TEL}, ' '), NVL(SUBSTRB(#{CST_SND_CST_ADDR}, 1, 100), ' '),
NVL(#{CST_ORD_CST_COD}, ' '), NVL(SUBSTRB(#{CST_ORD_CST_NAM}, 1, 40), ' '), NVL(#{CST_ORD_CST_TEL}, ' '), NVL(SUBSTRB(#{CST_ORD_CST_ADDR}, 1, 100), ' '),
NVL(#{CST_ARV_CST_COD}, ' '), NVL(SUBSTRB(#{CST_ARV_CST_NAM}, 1, 40), ' '), NVL(#{CST_ARV_CST_TEL}, ' '), NVL(SUBSTRB(#{CST_ARV_CST_ADDR}, 1, 100), ' '), NVL(#{PRD_COD}, ' '), NVL(TO_NUMBER(#{DLV_QTY}), 0), NVL(#{CHIT_NUM}, ' '), NVL(#{CAR_NUM}, ' '), NVL(#{TRN_CST_NAM}, ' '), NVL(#{DRIVER_NAM}, ' '), NVL(#{DRIVER_TEL}, ' '),
NVL(#{ITEM}, ' '), NVL(#{ETC_DESC}, ' '),
NVL(#{KPP_GET_YN}, 'N'), SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(MAX(SEND_SEQ), 0) + 1 AS SEND_SEQ FROM TB_WMS_PALLET_IF WHERE SEND_DAT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')
